title: Identity assertion evidence rubric and scheduled KMS rotation acceptance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures a product-level PRD addendum that defines the evidence rubric, integration tests, and the sign-off checklist required for accepting SSO (SAML 2.0) federation, RBAC delegation mapping, audit log guarantees, and scheduled KMS/HSM rotation behavior for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Scope clarifications in this doc: 1) SSO must support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML flows, SAML metadata import, and attribute mapping for group->role mapping; 2) RBAC must support delegated operator roles, least-privilege templates, and fine-grained API-scoped permissions; 3) Audit logs must be tamper-evident, immutable for minimum retention window, and surfaced to customer export endpoints; 4) KMS rotation must support scheduled automated symmetric key rotation, manual rotation, and HSM-backed key import/export proof of custody. The addendum also defines the minimum evidence package (integration runbook, passing test artifacts, GitHub PR linking implementation, Confluence evidence page, and acceptance sign-off matrix). This ticket is scoped to the acceptance criteria and evidence gating for the Private product onboarding flow; it does not change operator UX or billing surface (those are separate PM tickets).
acceptance_criteria: SSO: Demonstrable SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows with two IdPs (Okta and ADFS) configured using provided metadata; screenshots and single-request SAML traces included in evidence pack.

Attribute mapping: group->role mapping works end-to-end for at least 3 sample groups (engineer, admin, auditor), with role enforcement tested against API endpoints (create deployment, read billing, view audit).
RBAC: Delegated operator role created and exercised by an operator account; attempted privilege escalation is blocked and logged. Unit tests and integration tests pass in CI with policy fixtures.

Audit logs: Delivery to customer S3 endpoint + local log retention validated; logs include immutable append-only proof (hash chain) and an automated daily integrity snapshot; retention policy configurable to 365 days. Evidence: delivered logs + integrity snapshot verification script.

KMS rotation: Scheduled rotation completes successfully in staging and is validated by decrypting a test secret post-rotation; HSM fallback path tested by simulating HSM operator failure and demonstrating auto-failover to software keystore with audit trace.

Incident replay: A synthetic incident is executed (expired cert and failed federation) and the runbook demonstrates recovery steps with timestamps and owner attributions included in the evidence pack.
Documentation: Confluence PRD addendum and onboarding checklist published, and linked in the evidence pack. Acceptance requires sign-off from Security, Infra Eng, and Solutions Onboarding.
Release gating: Feature flagged for private deployments and validated end-to-end in a dedicated private tenant before GA per the release 'private-2026.04'.

2026-03-10 - QA (R. Chen): Ran smoke integration in staging tenant: SSO flows passed; discovered inconsistent timestamp timezone on audit snapshots (UTC vs local). Filed ENG-69202 to normalize timestamp formatting.

notes: Decision log: We chose an evidence-first acceptance model to reduce subjective sign-offs. Trade-offs: tighter evidence requirements increase onboarding time by ~2 weeks but materially reduce audit churn for enterprise customers. We will iterate on the rubric after first 3 customer onboards.
